patterns: APPSC asks AP power numbers with a date (installed capacity, Simhadri 2000 MW) and 'which source is NOT in AP's mix' (nuclear).
Institution founding dates: APIDC (1960) vs APIIC (1973) - date-recall items with close distractors.
Proportion-style items (Pranahita needs ~one-third of AP capacity) and scheme recall (UDAY for DISCOM debt).
App leans heavily on 2025-26 Survey figures and current events (SCoR zone, Bhogapuram, policies) in statement form; PYQs are single-fact.
